analysisRuntime.promptBody: The analysis runtime powers beat grid, BPM and Stem analysis. The {title} build can be downloaded now, about {size}.
analysisRuntime.promptBodyFeature: It is not installed yet. Download the {title} build (about {size}).
analysisRuntime.featureUpdateBody: The current component does not support this feature. Download or update to the {title} build (about {size}).
analysisRuntime.promptHint: Run the same action again once it finishes installing. If GitHub is unreachable, enable a VPN or configure the system proxy.
analysisRuntime.downloadInProgressHint: "{feature}" cannot be used until it finishes installing. Nothing was submitted this time.
analysisRuntime.downloadInProgressHintGeneric: The analysis runtime is downloading or extracting. Features that need it stay unavailable until it finishes.
analysisRuntime.downloadInProgressProgressHint: See the Downloads card in the bottom-right corner.
analysisRuntime.readyHint: The {title} build is installed. Run the same action again.
analysisRuntime.unsupportedHint: No analysis runtime component matches this computer's hardware.
analysisRuntime.unsupportedHintFeature: "{feature}" needs the analysis runtime, but no compatible component build is available for this computer.
analysisRuntime.manifestUnavailableHint: Unable to fetch the analysis runtime manifest. This is usually a network or proxy issue.
analysisRuntime.downloadFailedHint: Installation failed, so "{feature}" is unavailable for now.
analysisRuntime.downloadFailedHintGeneric: Installation failed. Features that depend on it are unavailable for now.
analysisRuntime.horizontalBlockedHint: "Dual-deck horizontal / edit mode" needs the analysis runtime. The current component does not support it.
analysisRuntime.stemBlockedHint: "Stem workspace" needs the analysis runtime. The current component does not support it.
analysisRuntime.trackAnalysisBlockedHint: "Beat grid / BPM analysis" needs the analysis runtime. It is not installed, so nothing was submitted.
analysisRuntime.trackAnalysisDownloadingHint: "Beat grid / BPM analysis" has to wait for it to finish. Nothing was submitted this time.
